_comment: Recorded-format fixture, AUTHORED FROM API DOCS (DESIGN.md §13). Shape: the error body a Google API returns when it is not enabled in the project (reason accessNotConfigured). dnsrecords.go maps it to a short apiDisabledError, never to a permission to grant.

error.message: Cloud DNS API has not been used in project 123456789012 before or it is disabled. Enable it by visiting https://console.developers.google.com/apis/api/dns.googleapis.com/overview?project=123456789012 then retry.
